SELECT ar.id, ar.automation_id, ar.action_id, ar.entity_type, ar.entity_id, ar.branch, ar.status, ar.detail, ar.ran_at,
  a.name AS automation_name, aa.action_type,
  CASE ar.entity_type
    WHEN 'contact' THEN (SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(CONCAT(c.first_name, ' ', c.last_name)), '') FROM contacts c WHERE c.id = ar.entity_id)
    WHEN 'company' THEN (SELECT co.name FROM companies co WHERE co.id = ar.entity_id)
    WHEN 'pipeline' THEN (SELECT o.name FROM opportunities o WHERE o.id = ar.entity_id)
    WHEN 'task' THEN (SELECT act.subject FROM activities act WHERE act.id = ar.entity_id)
    WHEN 'calendar' THEN (SELECT act.subject FROM activities act WHERE act.id = ar.entity_id)
    WHEN 'ticket' THEN (SELECT t.subject FROM tickets t WHERE t.id = ar.entity_id)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS entity_label,
  COUNT(*) OVER() AS total_count
FROM automation_runs ar
JOIN automations a ON a.id = ar.automation_id
LEFT JOIN automation_actions aa ON aa.id = ar.action_id
WHERE ($1::int IS NULL OR ar.automation_id = $1)
  AND ($2::text IS NULL OR ar.status = $2)
ORDER BY ar.ran_at DESC
LIMIT $3 OFFSET $4;
SELECT id, role, active FROM users WHERE id = $1 LIMIT 1;

SELECT a.id AS automation_id, a.name AS automation_name,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ar.status = 'success') AS success_count,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ar.status = 'error') AS error_count,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ar.status = 'unsupported') AS unsupported_count,
  MAX(ar.ran_at) AS last_ran_at
FROM automation_runs ar
JOIN automations a ON a.id = ar.automation_id
WHERE ($1::int IS NULL OR ar.automation_id = $1)
GROUP BY a.id, a.name
ORDER BY last_ran_at DESC;
